# Text markup reference

TextBlock, Run, MarkupTextBlock, and Label.

### Run

Receiver: `Run`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Background(Color? value)` | `Background` | Sets the highlight color painted behind the run; null paints nothing. |
| `BaselineOffset(double value)` | `BaselineOffset` | Sets the baseline shift in DIPs; positive raises the run above the line's baseline. |
| `Bold()` | `FontWeight = Bold` | Renders the run bold. |
| `Decoration(TextDecoration value)` | `Decoration` | Sets underline and strikethrough for the run. |
| `FontFamily(string value)` | `FontFamily` | Sets the font family; null inherits from the owning text element. |
| `FontSize(double? value)` | `FontSize` | Sets the font size in points; null inherits from the owning text element. |
| `FontWeight(FontWeight? value)` | `FontWeight` | Sets the font weight; null inherits from the owning text element. |
| `Foreground(Color? value)` | `Foreground` | Sets the text color; null inherits from the owning text element. |
| `Italic(bool value = true)` | `Italic` | Sets whether the run renders italic. |
| `Strikethrough()` |  | Adds a strikethrough, keeping any other decoration. |
| `Text(string value)` | `Text` | Sets the run text. |
| `Underline()` |  | Adds an underline, keeping any other decoration. |

### Label

Receiver: `Label` and derived types (`where T : Label`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AccessKeyTarget(UIElement target)` |  | Sets Target, the element that receives the access key activation. |
| `BindText(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, string> convert)` | `bind Text` | Binds the text to a converted observable value. |
| `BindText(ObservableValue<string> source)` | `bind Text` | Binds the text to an observable value. |
| `Target(UIElement value)` | `Target` | Sets the element that receives OnAccessKey when this label's access key is activated; null lets the access key bubble up the parent chain. |
| `Text(string value)` | `Text` | Sets the text; an underscore prefix marks the access key character (e.g. "_Name" registers Alt+N) and a double underscore is a literal underscore. |
| `TextAlignment(TextAlignment value)` | `TextAlignment` | Sets the horizontal text alignment. |
| `TextTrimming(TextTrimming value)` | `TextTrimming` | Sets the text trimming mode. |
| `TextWrapping(TextWrapping value)` | `TextWrapping` | Sets the text wrapping mode. |
| `VerticalTextAlignment(TextAlignment value)` | `VerticalTextAlignment` | Sets the vertical text alignment. |

### MarkupTextBlock

Receiver: `MarkupTextBlock`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Markup(string value)` | `Markup` | Sets the source markup. |
| `Options(TextMarkupOptions options)` | `Options` | Sets markup presentation options. |

### TextBlock

Receiver: `TextBlock` and derived types (`where T : TextBlock`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindText(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, string> convert)` | `bind Text` | Binds the text to a converted observable value. |
| `BindText(ObservableValue<string> source)` | `bind Text` | Binds the text to an observable value. |
| `Bold()` | `FontWeight = Bold` | Sets the font weight to bold. |
| `FontSize(ThemeFontSize size)` | `FontSize` | Sets the font size resolved once from the current theme's ThemeMetrics; themes with per-variant metrics re-resolve by calling this inside a WithTheme callback. |
| `Inlines(params Run[] runs)` | `Inlines` | Replaces the block's inline runs. |
| `Italic(bool italic = true)` |  | Sets the font style to italic, or back to upright. |
| `SemiBold()` | `FontWeight = SemiBold` | Sets the font weight to semi-bold. |
| `Text(string value)` | `Text` | Sets the text content; setting it replaces Inlines, and while runs are present the value is their concatenated text. |
